name: Stackless GPU Raycasting with Octree Traversal
aliases: Stackless octree traversal on the GPU
definition: A raycasting algorithm that computes the volume rendering integral by enumerating non-empty bricks in front-to-back order, adapting sampling density to brick resolution, and stopping when accumulated opacity exceeds a threshold. It uses the octree with neighbor structure to accelerate traversal without a stack.
summary: Stackless GPU Raycasting with Octree Traversal renders sparse volumetric data on the GPU without a stack, distinguishing itself by implicitly calculating neighbor lookups via the octree's regular structure.
